outline:
課程介紹電腦基本常識、人工智慧相關應用、程式設計簡介，內容包含資料型態、流程控制、函式、副程式、陣列與字串、檔案、應用程式設計以及類神經網路與深度學習簡介。
了解了生成式人工智慧的技術基礎、應用與挑戰。深入解說生成對抗網路（GAN）、深度學習、自然語言處理（NLP）等技術，並知道這些技術如何在文字、圖像、音訊、影片等多模態數據中應用。
不僅詳細剖析了從文本生成圖像、自動生成簡報等具體應用，還探討了生成式AI在創意設計、商業、教育和醫療等領域的廣泛影響。此外，讓學生對生成式AI的倫理與社會影響進行深刻反思，提醒學生在技術進步的同時，也要謹慎看待潛在風險與挑戰。

This course introduces basic computer knowledge, artificial intelligence applications, and an overview of programming, covering data types, flow control, functions, subroutines, arrays and strings, files, application programming, and an introduction to neural networks and deep learning.

It provides an understanding of the technological foundations, applications, and challenges of generative artificial intelligence. It delves into technologies such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), deep learning, and Natural Language Processing (NLP), demonstrating how these technologies are applied to multimodal data including text, images, audio, and video.

The course not only analyzes specific applications such as generating images from text and automatically generating presentations, but also explores the broad impact of generative AI in creative design, business, education, and healthcare. Furthermore, it encourages students to reflect deeply on the ethical and social impacts of generative AI, reminding them to be cautious about potential risks and challenges while pursuing technological advancements.
